Subject: Security kickoff - clarifications on scope and docs needed

Hi Alex / Priya - thanks for the intro, and looking forward to the kickoff on Tue 11/24 09:00 PT. A few clarifications so we can make the session efficient: 

1) Systems in scope (please confirm):
   - Care-coordinator UI (web app) - hosting model (Brightwell-managed vs. Redwood-managed?)
   - EHR exports - confirm schema and whether PHI will be redacted/anonymized before transfer. For the initial assessment, anonymized extracts are sufficient; if you need Redwood to connect to live EHR later in the POC we'll document required controls.
2) Data flows - please provide a simple diagram or bullet list for: source (EHR) -> transform (anonymization) -> storage (S3/bucket) -> Redwood ingestion.
3) Expected scale for POC: concurrent users, daily docs processed, average sequence length (tokens). If you don't have exact numbers, provide estimated ranges (low/medium/high).
4) Requested docs we can share pre-kickoff: SOC 2 Type II summary, encryption-at-rest architecture, key management approach, and our standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA). I'll attach our SOC 2 summary in the invite.

Agenda suggestion (30-45m):
- Introductions & roles (5m)
- Scope confirmation (systems + data flows) (10-15m)
- Questionnaire intake (pages 2-7) - focused Q&A (10-15m)
- Next steps & timeline (5m)

If you can drop the anonymized sample and a simple data flow before Tue, we'll be able to accelerate the intake and flag any missing controls early.

Thanks - Neha Kapoor
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com
